RESULT [continual]: A ViT-G soup reached 90.94% ImageNet top-1, a new state of the art at the time. It also improved out-of-distribution and zero-shot performance.
US [continual]: The greedy-soup rule, 'add an ingredient only if validation does not drop', is the professor's accept-or-rollback loop in weight space. It suits the laser robot, which can only run one model. The repo already trains several seeds of one recipe (e.g. M1 seeds 101-103), which are natural soup ingredients.
